topic: Ivanti Connect Secure RCE Chain (CVE-2026-XXXX) - Active Exploitation in the Wild
post_text:
Your VPN is probably vulnerable right now, and you don't know it.

This week, a critical remote code execution chain was discovered in Ivanti Connect Secure—affecting thousands of organizations globally. Attackers are already exploiting it in the wild, and patches are lagging behind active attacks.

Why this matters:
Ivanti Connect Secure is the gateway to your network. If it falls, everything behind it is exposed. We're talking lateral movement, data exfiltration, ransomware deployment—all without your users knowing a thing.

Three concrete takeaways for defenders:

1. Assume breach, verify nothing: Audit all Ivanti Connect Secure logs for past 90 days. Look for anomalous authentication chains and suspicious session activity.

2. Prioritize patching over everything else: This isn't a "nice to have." If you're running Ivanti Connect Secure, patching is mission-critical this week.

3. Deploy compensating controls now: Zero-trust network access, segmentation, and behavior-based detection can buy you time while patches roll out.

The hard truth? Many organizations won't patch until they're breached. Don't be one of them.

What's your take? Comment below.
